entries.label: Equity risk premium
entries.how: the market-value-weighted implied return of the 500 largest covered companies (each the median of its DCF, owner-earnings, Easton and residual-income implied costs of capital) less the 10-year Treasury (7.50% − 5.10%); the earnings yield of the 500 largest less the real 10-year yield gives 1.65% (the range)
entries.feeds: every cost of equity and WACC: the DCFs, residual income, the dividend models

entries.label: Terminal growth (base DCF, regime Monte Carlo)
entries.how: the 10-year Treasury yield, the market's long-run nominal rate: expected inflation (the breakeven, 2.50%) plus the real TIPS yield (2.60%); the usual ceiling for growth forever, since no company outgrows the economy for ever. The breakeven alone is the floor: inflation, no real growth
entries.feeds: the terminal value of the DCFs

entries.label: Growth cap of the Gordon models
entries.how: the same long-run nominal rate as above
entries.feeds: justified P/B and P/TBV, the dividend discount model

entries.label: Stage premium of the exit-multiple method
entries.how: the median implied return of high-growth companies less that of mature ones (254 and 308 companies): the extra return the market asks of growth today; pre-profit companies have no implied return, so this is a lower bound for them

entries.label: Liquidation value: share of tangible book recovered
entries.how: the median price ÷ tangible book of the 16 covered companies with a one-year distress probability of 10% or more: what the market pays for the assets of companies that may fail (a going-concern price, so an upper bound for a forced sale)

entries.label: No-growth P/E (Graham formula)
entries.how: the median P/E of the 163 profitable covered companies whose revenue grew within ±2% over the last four quarters

entries.label: 10-year Treasury when none is on file
entries.how: the 10-year Treasury yield today (used only when the rates feed is missing)
entries.feeds: the cost of equity, the cost of debt fallback

entries.label: Working capital per dollar of new revenue
entries.how: the median non-cash working capital (current assets − cash − current liabilities) ÷ revenue of 1445 non-financial companies: in a steady state each new dollar of revenue ties up the same share

entries.label: Tax rate when the company's own is not usable
entries.how: the median effective tax rate (tax ÷ pretax income, 0–35%) of the 1439 companies whose own rate is usable
entries.feeds: every after-tax figure of the companies without a usable rate

entries.label: Terminal ROIC: the band its own ROIC is held in
entries.how: the 10th–90th percentile of today's return on invested capital (NOPAT ÷ equity + debt − cash) across 1289 non-financial companies (the median beside it)
entries.feeds: the terminal value of the DCFs

entries.label: Revenue per dollar of invested capital (when its own is missing)
entries.how: the median revenue ÷ invested capital of 1293 non-financial companies
entries.feeds: the reinvestment of the real-option and FCFE lenses

entries.label: Weight on a company's own beta (Blume adjustment)
entries.how: the slope of each company's beta over the last two years on its beta over the two years before, across 1765 companies (intercept 0.24): how much of a measured beta survives into the next period

entries.label: The band the WACC is held in
entries.how: the 5th–95th percentile of the unclamped WACC across 1855 companies (the median beside it)

entries.label: Half-life of a peer's past multiples (weighted peers)
entries.how: how fast a company's EV/Sales returns toward its own mean: quarterly persistence 0.79 over 26458 quarter pairs, a half-life of 0.7 years (corrected for the downward bias of short series)

entries.label: Days after a quarter ends before its figures count as known
entries.how: the 90th percentile of the days from the period's end to the filing of the latest 10-Q / 10-K of 3967 companies (median 36 days): by then nine in ten have filed
entries.feeds: the base rates, the valuation bands, the backtests

entries.label: Loss given default (credit spreads)
entries.how: the ISDA standard CDS contract assumes a 40% recovery for senior unsecured debt, a 60% loss
entries.feeds: the distress probability from bond spreads

entries.label: Graham's base Aaa yield
entries.how: Graham's formula divides by today's Aaa yield and multiplies by his 1962 yield of 4.4%: the 4.4% is part of the formula, today's yield is already the market's

entries.label: Forecast years of the DCF
entries.how: long enough for growth to fade toward the terminal rate, short enough to forecast; the terminal value carries the rest

entries.label: Monte Carlo scenarios
entries.how: enough draws for stable percentiles; seeded by ticker so a page does not change between builds

entries.label: Peers a group needs
entries.how: fewer make the median one company's multiple

entries.label: Largest weight of one peer
entries.how: a giant weighs most but is never the whole answer

entries.label: Matched-peer windows
entries.how: fixed before any result was seen; scored in the ledger

entries.label: Multiples kept
entries.how: beyond them the figure is a near-zero denominator, not a price

entries.label: Regime thresholds
entries.how: the Markov model's states; its transitions are estimated, the cut-offs are not

note: Fixed numbers are set in the code before any result is seen, so that a page cannot be tuned to a wanted answer. The market and data estimates beside them change with every build; a gap is a reason to look, not an automatic switch. Each company's DCF is shown with the market numbers swapped in below.
